columns_detail.col_name: Teachers Academic Responsibilities in a Day
text_samples: Teachers Academic Responsibilities in a Day
Teacher daily takes 3 period which is fix. since he is the only teacher in the school, he has to take rest of subjects as well like Hindi and Sanskrit.

Teacher conducts 4 classes in the day, beyond that he took some extra classes like moral education, give some time to improve student learning skills. During the break he also oversee over the children during they were playing the game. As he is senior teacher and have some health so he hardly participate in the other activities.

columns_detail.col_name: Key feedback to improve training session design or in-person training in general
text_samples: Key feedback to improve training session design or in-person training in general
real classroom demo video help to connect more during training.

Teacher finds in person training, but he highlighted that there is issue at the block level. At the block level official look at this activity as timepass, so People dont take training seriously.  He highlighted the issue in the structure of training, he suggested there should be four group based on the geograpahies and context. So, training should cater differently for all these group based on their experiences.  Select MTs from the more interior like tribal areas and select the MTs who are more interested in training and that subject.

text_samples: Key observation on teacher's motivation, awareness, challenges of non-participation
It has been observed that teachers was not motivated for the academic activities and he was unable to describe any learning from it.

columns_detail.col_name: General perception on Teacher mentoring and classroom observation process
text_samples: General perception on Teacher mentoring and classroom observation process
according to teacher classroom observation means any official comes to classroom for observation on student assessment, syllabus completion.

Teacher has affirmative response about the CRO and TM, He highlighted this need to be there in the place. At least once a month every teacher classroom needs to observe by any official or even villagers can come, and time to time mentoring from senior also needed. Teacher mainly see CRO as mainly seeing the class of the teacher how he is teaching and how children were responding. Teacher overally find this process as supportive mechanism for the teacher.

columns_detail.col_name: What should be kept in mind by mentor official mentors while doing CRO & Mentoring

After giving prompt question teacher explained mentoring means - CAC/ Officials should support in classroom process, take lectures when it required

The official who ever coming should come with the helping mindset, and coordination between both need to be there. Official should come as mentor (salahkar) rather than doing any disciplinary action, Also come with mindset of the exact reality and context of school.

columns_detail.col_name: Key observation notes Annual Engagement
text_samples: Key observation notes (Annual Engagement)

The teacher demonstrated good recall of the different professional development activities attended during the year, though specific dates and timelines were not remembered. Responses reflected regular engagement with academic learning opportunities and training programs.

शिक्षक वर्ष भर विभिन्न शैक्षणिक एवं विभागीय गतिविधियों में सक्रिय रूप से जुड़े रहे। उन्होंने विषय आधारित शैक्षिक संवाद (CLSS), सीख की यात्रा तथा अन्य विभागीय कार्यक्रमों में नियमित भागीदारी की। शिक्षक प्रशिक्षणों से प्राप्त सीख को कक्षा में लागू करने का प्रयास करते हैं और नई शिक्षण रणनीतियों को अपनाने के प्रति सकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण रखते हैं। हालांकि, शैक्षणिक कार्यों के साथ-साथ प्रशासनिक एवं गैर-शैक्षणिक जिम्मेदारियों के कारण समय प्रबंधन एक चुनौती के रूप में सामने आया। इसके बावजूद शिक्षक अपनी व्यावसायिक सीख को निरंतर बढ़ाने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध दिखाई दिए।

columns_detail.col_name: Key observation note on access and adoption of training material
text_samples: Key observation note on access and adoption of training material

The teacher did not receive any training materials or resources. However, the teacher recalled and adopted some key practices from the training, such as checking students' prior knowledge, using topic hooks, and cold calling techniques, and found them useful in classroom teaching.

शिक्षक को प्रशिक्षण के दौरान उपलब्ध कराई गई PPT, मार्गदर्शिका एवं अन्य शिक्षण सामग्री तक पहुँच प्राप्त हुई। शिक्षक ने बताया कि प्रशिक्षण में साझा की गई रणनीतियों, जैसे समूह कार्य, प्रभावी गृहकार्य एवं पुनरावलोकन गतिविधियों को कक्षा में लागू करने का प्रयास किया गया। शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण सामग्री को उपयोगी एवं व्यवहारिक मानते हैं, क्योंकि यह सीधे कक्षा शिक्षण से जुड़ी है। हालांकि, कार्यभार एवं समय की सीमाओं के कारण सभी सुझावों का नियमित और पूर्ण रूप से उपयोग कर पाना हमेशा संभव नहीं हो पाता। समग्र रूप से शिक्षक प्रशिक्षण सामग्री को अपनाने के प्रति सकारात्मक एवं उत्साही दिखाई दिए।
